items.a: Yes. Your photos and metadata stay on your device. Siegu uses on-device AI, so nothing is uploaded for processing.
Absolutely. Your library is stored locally, so you can browse and search your photos anywhere — even without a connection.
You can share a collection over a live, end-to-end-encrypted link. Guests only see what you choose to share, and nothing is stored on our side.

items.q: Can I access my photos over mobile data or while traveling?
items.a: Yes. Free users can point their app at a self-hosted relay on a machine they own (port-forwarding one UDP port). Pro's hosted relay does the same with zero setup — it works even on cellular networks that block direct connections.

items.q: Why do I need a relay at all?
items.a: To connect over the internet, two devices have to find each other. Most home networks work out of the box, but some networks (especially mobile data) sit behind NATs a direct connection can't reach. A relay — TURN — forwards the encrypted stream between your devices when that happens. It never stores or reads your media.
Siegu runs on Windows, macOS and Linux, with a full web experience for guests.

items.q: Can I import from Google Photos or iCloud?
items.a: Yes — Siegu imports your existing library, then processes it all locally and privately.

items.q: Is there a demo I can try?
items.a: Yes! Open the live demo to see Siegu in action right in your browser — no install or account needed.
